# Talentro

> Talentro sources, screens and coordinates European specialists for defined AI, clinical research, regulatory and engineering projects.

## Pages
- [Services and project enquiries](https://www.talentro.tech/): Describe expertise, scope, location, language and timeline.
- [Blog](https://blog.talentro.tech/): Articles on specialist expertise and project planning.
- [Privacy](https://www.talentro.tech/privacy.html): Information about enquiry data.
